Name: Zilker Park
Description: Growing up in Austin, this is where I have some of my first memories playing on the playground. It is also where I go to ACL almost every year, so it feels tied to so many of my favorite Austin memories.

Name: Lake Travis
Address: 4370 Mansfield Dam Park Rd, Austin, TX 78732
Description: Lake Travis is the lake I grew up on. I grew up fishing there, being on the water, and doing water sports, so it has always felt like home to me.

Name: Angel's Icehouse
Description: I grew up going here, and it has been a family spot for as long as I can remember. My parents used to put me on the table in a baby bucket when I was little, so it is one of those places that has basically always been part of my life.

Name: Civil Goat on Cuernavaca
Address: 704 N Cuernavaca Dr N, Austin, TX 78733
Description: This is my favorite coffee spot. It feels cozy and familiar, and it is one of my favorite places to go when I want a relaxed morning.

Name: Commons Ford Ranch
Address: 614 N Commons Ford Rd, Austin, TX 78733
Description: This is my favorite place to hike. It is peaceful, pretty, and feels like such a good escape while still being close to Austin.

Name: Maudie's Hill Country Galleria
Description: This is my classic Friday night fajita spot. It is one of those places that feels tied to family routines and easy weekend memories.

Name: Amy's Ice Cream on South Congress
Description: This is such a childhood staple for me. I always connect it with walking around South Congress, and it is one of the first places I think of when I think about Austin.

Name: Swedish Hill
Description: This is my favorite casual restaurant. I love that it feels cute and a little special without being too formal.

Name: Neighborhood Sushi
Description: This is my favorite sushi ever. It is one of those places I would be genuinely excited to take someone because I love it that much.

Name: Saint Bernard
Address: 3201 Bee Caves Rd Ste 142, Austin, TX 78746
Description: This is my all-time favorite place to shop. It is one of those stores I can never just quickly stop in without wanting to look at everything.

Name: It's All Good Barbeque
Description: This is my favorite barbeque spot. Whenever I am out that way, it is one of the first places I think about going.

Name: Barton Springs
Description: This is my favorite place to tan and hang out with friends in the summer, usually with a snow cone. It feels like the most classic Austin summer day to me.
